styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF and light grey #EDEFF1 seamless panels for product shots; mint-cyan #86C9C5 and muted slate #9A9CA8 panels for feature and information screens; a single deep slate-teal #2E4A4E panel only on the closing screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting with a cool front-left key and soft fill, soft contact shadows grounding every product, low-contrast controlled highlights on the matte shell
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper, light grey marble-grain block pedestals #DCDEE1 and a light wood desk #C9A57B, no busy texture
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type, ink #2B3A42 on light panels and #FFFFFF on dark panels, labels in rounded pill chips; mint-cyan #86C9C5 kept as a secondary panel fill rather than a text color

styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright product scale with the round fan head up and the handle down, consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and clean silhouette with a soft contact shadow; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh airy summer cooling-appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, light neutral panel #EDEFF1, deep ink #2B3A42 and one coral accent #F08A6D, with one mint-cyan secondary #86C9C5 kept as a panel fill in feature screens; cool bright diffused studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline type; consistent rounded pill label chips and thin-line icons; clean high-end appliance photography mixed with minimal infographic panels; stable upright product scale with the head up and handle down and a consistent slight 3/4 hero angle; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 12 张手持小风扇爆款详情页长图切片提炼。已剥离：源品牌与店铺标识、会员招募二维码与促销贴图、机型代号、原文案与独特手写体排版、配色中文名（改为 {callout} 文案槽位由使用方填写）。原图中未经验证的续航时长、音量与风力数值一律改为 {callout} 或 {selling_point} 槽位由使用方填写，不发明任何认证与检测数据；产品一律以 {product} 占位，机位/光位/背景/占比等可复用视觉语法保留并以 hex 记述。
